logo_concept.concept_description: A precision telecommunications mark combining a solid rounded rectangular call-signal shield with twin crisp wave arcs and an integrated cloud node, paired with bold geometric typography in Plus Jakarta Sans.

landing_hero_replacement.action: Replace Three.js 3D globe (Hero3D.js) with a high-fidelity interactive Live Softphone & Call Routing Control Panel Mockup, framed beside a professional enterprise call center support agent photo.
landing_hero_replacement.hero_mockup_structure: A sleek 2-column hero: Left side has crisp headline 'Enterprise Virtual Phone Numbers & Smart IVR in 17 Countries', trust badges (99.99% Uptime, Carrier Grade, Instant Provisioning), search box for country numbers, and primary 'Get Started' button. Right side features an interactive browser softphone card with active call waveform, incoming call notification simulation, country flag dropdown selector, and real support photo overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace Google Font import in cloudivr.css with Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter.
2. Update CSS variables in cloudivr.css to map dark background variables to light corporate background (#F8FAFC, #FFFFFF, #E2E8F0) and green accent (#34d399) to enterprise sky blue (#0284C7).
3. Update cloudivr.css component rules (civr-card, civr-btn-primary, civr-input, civr-pill, civr-glass) removing heavy glows, dark fills, and 3D trace effects.
4. Modify Landing.js and Hero.js: Replace 3D globe (Hero3D) with clean 2-column hero featuring interactive phone simulator card and real stock photo asset from media_assets.
5. Ensure ALL data-testid attributes across all components and buttons remain 100% intact.
6. Verify i18n support, routes under /cloudivr, softphone modal, wallet payments, and mobile nav bar render cleanly without text contrast or overlap issues.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark background gradients or neon glows for enterprise telecom interfaces.
Ensure all text meets WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1 ratio for normal text).
Maintain responsive grid layouts with direct children alignment and subgrid support where applicable.
Ensure all interactive elements include data-testid attributes.
